All collections are ordinary finite dense arrays/lists, not subclasses, proxies, sparse arrays or accessor-backed collections. Node fields, where present, are ordinary data fields. Python integer inputs are plain int excluding bool; any separately declared floating probabilities are ordinary float.
return: Fresh length-n array of total seats booked on each flight 1 through n, with inclusive first/last booking endpoints.
mutation_aliasing: Inputs and booking rows remain unchanged. Difference array and output are distinct new arrays; no mutable input aliases escape. The Solution instance retains no state.
numeric: Each signed delta partial sum lies in [-S,S]; accumulated active seats lie in [0,S]. Subtracting at index last implements exclusive zero-based end after the inclusive flight endpoint. All integer inputs and integer intermediates (apart from opaque Python identity keys) remain in [-9007199254740991,9007199254740991]; no bitwise coercion is used.
complexity: O(n + b + 1) time and O(n + 1) auxiliary/output space for b bookings, including both n+1 difference entries and n returned totals.
